taken as written, as anagram fodder

clue.text: A new day, before long, brings about much of the same

taken as written

blocks.note: standard abbreviation for company

taken as written

explanation.surface: Something like balloons, which can be blown up and very big.

clue.text: Aim of protest

first letter of the word
first letter of the word
first letter of the word

final letter of the word

blocks.note: taken as written, as anagram fodder
taken as written

first and last letters of the word

clue.text: Match of some incomparable quality

blocks.note: spans the end of the first word and start of the second

first letter of the word

clue.text: As a rule, no soldiers band together
